import os, stat, hashlib, subprocess, json
from pathlib import Path
import support as common
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def git(wt, *args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '--no-optional-locks', *args], cwd=wt)


def source_guard(variant):
    wt = Path(variant['worktree'])
    assert git(wt, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').decode().strip() == variant['head']
    assert git(wt, 'branch', '--show-current').decode().strip() == variant['branch']
    assert not git(wt, 'diff', '--cached', '--name-only').strip()
    assert sorted(git(wt, 'diff', '--name-only').decode().splitlines()) == variant['owned_paths']
    assert not git(wt, 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '-z').strip()
    raw = (ROOT / variant['source_map']).read_bytes()
    assert common.sha(raw) == variant['source_map_sha256']
    expected = json.loads(raw)
    entries = git(wt, 'ls-files', '-s', '-z').rstrip(b'\0').split(b'\0')
    assert len(entries) == len(expected) == variant['tracked_paths']
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    for entry, row in zip(entries, expected):
        meta, name = entry.split(b'\t', 1)
        mode, blob, stage = meta.split()
        assert stage == b'0' and name.decode() == row['path']
        assert mode.decode() == row['mode'] and blob.decode() == row['base_blob']
        f = wt / row['path']
        actual_mode = '120000' if f.is_symlink() else '100755' if f.stat().st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR else '100644'
        data = os.fsencode(os.readlink(f)) if f.is_symlink() else f.read_bytes()
        assert actual_mode == row['mode'] and len(data) == row['bytes'] and common.sha(data) == row['sha256'], row['path']
        digest.update(name + b'\0' + mode + b'\0' + data)
    runtime = (wt / 'lampOS/crates/expression/tests/runtime.rs').read_bytes()
    assert b'controlled_no_pause_setup_once' not in runtime
    assert b'LAMP_TEST_NO_PAUSE_SETUP_GATE' not in runtime
    return digest.hexdigest()


def all_guards():
    return {v['name']: source_guard(v) for v in PLAN['variants']}


def file_binding(path):
    return {'path': str(path), 'sha256': common.sha(path.read_bytes()),
            'mode': oct(stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode)), 'bytes': path.stat().st_size}
